generate_bccd_dummy_data: run the bccd dummy data generator to create fake JPEG images and annotation XML files for testing
generate_trainval_archive: generate train and validation dummy data sets with fake blood cell detection images and annotations
generate_test_archive: generate test dummy data set with fake blood cell detection images and annotations
generate_jpeg_image: generate a fake JPEG image for a given example id with specified height and width dimensions
generate_annotation_xml: generate a fake VOC-style annotation XML with random bounding boxes and class labels for an example
